title: Hardware Procurement Service Charge Schedule: Staging, Handling and Rush
content:
## Schedule of service charges by order type (USD)

Hardware Procurement quotes carry three kinds of service charge besides the units themselves. The staging fee is charged per unit for imaging, enrollment, configuration or burn-in before shipment. The handling fee is charged once per order and covers receiving and shipping coordination. The rush fee is charged once per order for rush processing ahead of the queue, and only where the order type offers rush processing.

| Order type | Staging fee per unit | Handling fee per order | Rush fee per order | Rush processing can be quoted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | 0.00 | 15.00 | 50.00 | Yes |
| Standard Endpoint Order | 0.00 | 25.00 | 75.00 | Yes |
| Staged Endpoint Order | 95.00 | 25.00 | 150.00 | Yes |
| Network Equipment Order | 145.00 | 35.00 | 150.00 | Yes |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 395.00 | 75.00 | 350.00 | Yes |
| Special-Order Equipment | 0.00 | 75.00 | 0.00 | No |

## Notes

1. The staging fee is a per-unit figure: a hypothetical Network Equipment Order of 4 units carries 580.00 of staging, four times 145.00.
2. The handling fee and the rush fee are per-order figures and do not grow with the number of units.
3. Special-Order Equipment cannot be quoted with rush processing; its rush fee is shown as 0.00 for that reason.
